coverageNotes: The State Election Commission says an unfiltered Candidate Tracking search returns all candidates for the selected election. Both searches used all offices, all candidate statuses, all parties and all filing locations, with no county or name filters. Every Active candidate for each held contest is included from the full-territory official roster. Sources: https://vrems.scvotes.sc.gov/Candidate/CandidateSearch?electionId=22596 and https://vrems.scvotes.sc.gov/Candidate/CandidateSearch?electionId=22758

The official candidate-placement statement says: "In South Carolina, political parties are responsible for determining qualifications for their candidates and for certifying them for placement on the ballot in partisan elections." Source: https://scvotes.gov/placement-of-candidates-on-ballots-in-south-carolina/

The general-election roster contains all 124 state House districts and all seven U.S. House districts. The separate Special election selector lists SC Senate District 15 Special Election on November 3, 2026; its two Active candidates are included. Source: https://vrems.scvotes.sc.gov/Candidate/CandidateSearch?electionId=22758

The November 3, 2026 referendum search returned 42 Local Questions and zero Statewide Constitutional Amendments when checked. No statewide measure was listed. Source: https://vrems.scvotes.sc.gov/Candidate/ReferendumSearch?electionId=22596
Governor and Lieutenant Governor are held as four joint tickets with each current running mate preserved from the official export. Incumbency and campaign websites are not stated in the export.
